## Maintainer checklist

Public pull requests are currently disabled. Please use an issue for bug reports, feature requests, or support. This template applies only if maintainers enable pull requests in the future.

### Purpose

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any related issue.

### Verification

Describe the checks performed. For website changes, include affected links, desktop/mobile layout checks, and screenshots when relevant.

- [ ] This change concerns the website or community documentation, not private app source.
- [ ] No private documents, credentials, or personal information are included.
- [ ] Privacy, support, and availability claims still match actual product behavior.
- [ ] No change to licensing or asset reuse rights is included without the owner's explicit instruction.
